title: Blood Debt, Blood Repayment
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan spat blood, his hoarse voice uttering a name that made Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply—as if the sound came from the most forbidden memories within the Tianji Record, heralding a catastrophe more terrifying than the Demonic Path invasion that was brewing.

text.content: At the blood-stained hall entrance, Su Qingyao's silhouette appeared especially desolate in the morning light. The wound on her left shoulder revealed bone, her dark cyan Inner Disciple robe soaked through with blood, yet she stood firmly before Chen Ji, her sword-holding hand trembling slightly but never dropping. Chen Ji's brow shifted slightly, his gaze moving from the blood-stained ancient jade to her ashen face. Three breaths later, he spoke slowly, his voice tranquil to the point of coldness: 'Arriving in such a state to deliver news, it seems Ling Yuan's people are pressing close.' He didn't ask 'what happened,' as if everything was within expectation. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled within his Mental Sea, transmitting a profound sigh—mixed with both approval and worry.

dialogue.content: (Straining, eyes ablaze with urgency) Chen Ji, your chess game... he's seen through it all! Not only does Ling Yuan know about your hidden moves, but he's obtained the backup scroll you left in the scripture archive! He's waiting for you in the Council Hall, planning to publicly... publicly expose your 'treasonous' evidence!

text.content: When Chen Ji heard the word 'treason', a subtle curve appeared at the corner of his mouth. He lifted the tea that had long gone cold on the table, took a small sip, his movements so composed it seemed as if he was savoring a delicacy rather than facing utter disaster. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul anxiously spoke within his Mental Sea: 'Young one, the fourth possibility has been triggered—your Heavenly Fate...' Chen Ji calmly responded in his heart: Master, I've been waiting for this moment for three months. He set down the teacup, and his gaze toward Su Qingyao held a trace more warmth: 'You risked your life to deliver this message—are you here because you trust me, or because you don't want me to die?'

dialogue.content: (Cheeks slightly flushed, yet eyes burning with unwavering resolve) ...Both. But I'm here because I know you'll never lose! From the moment you had Ye Qing set an ambush in the Nether Valley, I knew your scheme ran far deeper than what I could see—so I'm betting you still have hidden cards!

text.content: Chen Ji heard this and finally rose. He approached Su Qingyao, gently adjusting her blood-stained collar as if the gesture was practiced countless times. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul clicked his tongue within his Mental Sea: 'Boy, when will you ever break this habit of playing favorites?' Chen Ji ignored his master's teasing, simply remarking: 'Ling Yuan wants to see my cards? Then let him—but what he doesn't know is that I never have just one trump card.' He turned toward the hall entrance, his silhouette stretching long in the morning light. Watching that retreating figure, Su Qingyao felt something within her chest soften unexpectedly.

choice.prompt: The Council Hall loomed ahead, and Chen Ji was about to face Ling Yuan's encirclement. Before stepping into the great hall, he needed to decide his strategy—

choices.description: Today's matter requires thorough elimination. Ling Yuan and his faction, not a single one spared. Demonstrate absolute overwhelming strength, causing all schemers to abandon their treacherous intentions.
choices.visible_cost: Exhausting 10 points of Heavenly Fate (accumulating previous expenditure)
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's faction completely purged, all internal threats within the Tianqing Sect eliminated
choices.risk_hint: Excessive bloodshed might cause some neutral disciples to become alienated

text.content: As Chen Ji stepped into the Council Hall, his aura dramatically shifted. The pressure he had carefully concealed erupted like a mountain collapse and tsunami, causing every lamp in the hall to extinguish and reignite simultaneously. His gaze toward Ling Yuan was like looking at a corpse: 'Since Director Ling is so eager to condemn me, then—' He paused, a mocking curve forming at his lips, 'Let me show you what true ironclad evidence looks like.'

choices.description: Only punish the chief culprits, leaving the coerced unpunished. Splinter and dissolve Ling Yuan's forces, causing his followers to defect on their own—reducing casualties while winning hearts.
choices.visible_cost: Requires more strategic planning and energy expenditure
choices.visible_reward: Gains gratitude from numerous defectors, with reputation soaring significantly
choices.risk_hint: Potential for surviving remnants that could plant future troubles

text.content: When Chen Ji entered the Council Hall, his presence instead收敛到极致. Scanning the surroundings, he catalogued each face showing fear or harboring schemes, then offered Ling Yuan a meaningful smile: 'Since Director Ling wishes to examine me, let's do exactly that—let all the fellow disciples hear precisely what you've been doing these past years.' His voice wasn't loud, yet every individual in the hall heard him clearly. Ling Yuan's expression flickered, sensing something was amiss.

choices.description: Though Ling Yuan betrayed, his decades of cultivation within the sect mean his connections and resources are invaluable. Turning him into a chess piece would transform an enemy into an asset.
choices.visible_cost: Requires bearing some risk and consuming more Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Ling Yuan's entire covert network would establish true dominance over the sect
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may not genuinely submit, potentially nurturing future betrayal

text.content: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the Council Hall, he had already deduced seventeen possibilities in his mind. He looked at Ling Yuan sitting high on the main seat, and suddenly smiled—that smile made an inexplicable chill run down Ling Yuan's back. Chen Ji walked forward slowly, his voice unhurried: 'Ling Sect Master, do you know why, even though I knew you were making moves in the shadows, I never fought back?' He paused, 'Because those things in your hands... I intentionally let you get them.'

Inside the Council Hall, dozens of elders and disciples stood in rows on both sides. Ling Yuan sat upright at the main seat, with more than ten loyal disciples standing behind him, each with a cold and fierce expression. In the center of the hall, three Servant Disciples bound with ropes knelt on the ground—these were members of the intelligence network that Chen Ji had secretly cultivated. They were covered in blood, clearly having been interrogated. When Ling Yuan saw Chen Ji enter, a smug smile appeared on his aged face: 'Chen Ji, you dare to come?' He slapped the armrest and stood up, 'Today, this old man will expose your treacherous true nature before the entire Sect!'

dialogue.content: (His gaze dark and gloomy, but his voice deliberately raised) Everyone! This fellow is merely a Servant Disciple, yet he secretly raised assassins, stole secrets from the scripture repository, and colluded with Demonic Path cultivators in secret—I have ironclad evidence, and today I shall替天行道 and eliminate this cancer who endangers the Sect!

text.content: The hall erupted in uproar. Those elders and disciples who didn't know the truth began whispering among themselves, their gazes toward Chen Ji filled with suspicion and fear. The three intelligence operatives kneeling on the ground trembled violently. One of them suddenly lifted his head, shouting in a ragged voice: 'Chen Shixiong! We have implicated you! That villain Ling used poison during interrogation, we said nothing—' Before he could finish, one of Ling Yuan's loyalists beside him kicked him in the chest, blood spouting out. Ling Yuan coldly said: 'Still trying to argue? Someone, seize Chen Ji as well!'

dialogue.content: (Stepping forward大步 and blocking before Ling Yuan, eyes full of hostility) Chen Ji! You barely defeated me at Xuanwu Sect that day, but now, in front of Sect Master Ling, let's see how long your arrogance lasts! If you have the guts, face me, Han Lie, in a real刀真枪 duel before the entire Sect!

text.content: Chen Ji swept his gaze across the room, his eyes finally settling on Su Qingyao. She stood resolutely at the hall's entrance, her sword already drawn, blood dripping from the blade, yet she refused to retreat a single step. At this moment, something inside Chen Ji was subtly moved. But on the surface, he merely glanced at Han Lie dismissively, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his mouth: 'Han Gongzi, do you need me to publicly recount how you lost that day?' He turned away from Han Lie's ashen face and faced Ling Yuan, his voice suddenly cold, 'Sect Master Ling claims I betrayed the Sect to enemies—fine, then let everyone see who truly is the traitor.'

Without another word, Chen Ji flicked his sleeve, and over a dozen Spiritual Lights shot out. These lights transformed mid-air into images—the scenes of secret meetings between Ling Yuan and Xuanwu Sect's envoys in the desolate mountains, complete with recorded conversations between the two. In the images, Ling Yuan's voice was clearly audible: '...as long as Chen Ji dies, the Tianji Record inheritance will fall into my hands, and then the Tianqing Sect and Xuanwu Sect will merge, and this old man will become the Sect Master...' The hall fell into deathly silence. Everyone's gaze landed on Ling Yuan, and on his pallid, paper-white old face, beads of sweat were dripping down.

dialogue.content: (His expression changed dramatically, lips trembling) This... this is fabricated! Chen Ji, you villain, you actually used illusion techniques to fabricate evidence—

text.content: Chen Ji coldly laughed and another Spiritual Light flew out. This light transformed into an ancient Jade Slip, suspended in the center of the hall. 'Sect Master Ling's private ledger—over three years, how many benefits you've received from Xuanwu Sect, and how much information about Sect disciples you've sold, it's all clearly recorded here.' He paused, his gaze sharp as a blade, 'Also, do you want to see the evidence of how you murdered your fellow disciple—my father Chen Xuan—to compete for the Tianji Record inheritance back then?' Mo Xiansheng whispered in his Mental Sea: 'Young man, once you take this step, there will be no turning back.' Chen Ji answered in his heart: Master, from the day I entered the cultivation world, I never planned to turn back.

Ling Yuan finally couldn't maintain his composure. He suddenly erupted, a powerful Spiritual Energy surging forth like a violent tide—this was the pressure of the Transformation God realm, and the entire Council Hall trembled violently under this pressure. 'Chen Ji! Even if this old man has to sacrifice his cultivation regression, I will drag you to die together!' However, Chen Ji only gently raised his hand, and a brilliant sword light shot out from his fingertip. That sword light appeared gentle, but contained the supreme principles of the Dao, and Ling Yuan's Spiritual Energy tide actually melted like ice and snow meeting the scorching sun, instantly dissipating. 'Sect Master Ling, you've forgotten one thing.' Chen Ji's voice was cold as a deity, 'My father, before he died, had already passed the Tianji Record inheritance to me—the thing you've pursued your entire life, is now in my hands.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's cultivation was suppressed by the Tianji Record's power, but he was still making a last desperate struggle. Han Lie, seeing this, was ready to move, and the situation in the hall was on the verge of erupting. Chen Ji needed to make a final decision—

choices.description: Spare Ling Yuan's life, but completely destroy his hundreds of years of cultivation, letting him experience the taste of falling from the clouds into the mud. Death would be less painful than living in suffering.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan's remaining forces might seek revenge at any moment
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, letting everyone witness the terror of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan faked his death and escaped, the troubles would be endless

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip gently flicked, and a mysterious rune pierced into Ling Yuan's Brow Center. The old Sect Master let out a miserable shriek as the surrounding Spiritual Energy gushed out like a breached dam. His cultivation was plummeting visibly to the naked eye—Transformation God realm, Yuan Ying realm, Golden Core realm... until he was completely reduced to a mortal. 'No—my cultivation—' Ling Yuan collapsed to the ground, his aged eyes filled with unwillingness and fear.

choices.description: Ling Yuan's crimes are unforgivable, execute him directly as a warning to others. Let Han Lie witness firsthand the fate of traitors.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan's desperate final struggle might cause collateral damage
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's faction will completely collapse, and people's hearts will归附
choices.risk_hint: Excessive killing might affect the subsequent plot development

text.content: Chen Ji spoke no more. He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment appeared in his palm. The ancient text moved like living creatures, transforming into a devastating pillar of light. 'Sect Master Ling, you murdered my father, betrayed the Sect, colluded with foreign enemies—according to Tianqing Sect's rules, you deserve death.' The pillar of light crashed down, and Ling Yuan didn't even have time to scream before he turned to ash in the blinding light. The hall was deathly silent.

dialogue.content: (His face livid, fists clenched tightly) Chen Ji! You... you actually dared to kill Sect Master Ling! Xuanwu Sect will never let you off—

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, his gaze falling on Han Lie. At this moment, that sharp edge he usually concealed burst forth completely, like a divine sword leaving its sheath. 'Han Gongzi, you just said you wanted a real sword and spear match with me?' His voice wasn't loud, yet it caused Han Lie to involuntarily step back. 'Unfortunately, you're not qualified.' Chen Ji reached out and grabbed, and Han Lie's Xuanwu Medal at his waist actually flew out by itself, landing in Chen Ji's palm. 'This is the trust token Xuanwu Sect gave you, right? From today onward, it belongs to me—and of course, if you insist on seeking death, I won't mind sending you to keep Sect Master Ling company.'

Han Lie's entire body stiffened, cold sweat beading on his forehead. He wanted to refute, but found his spiritual energy suppressed by an invisible force, unable to move at all—that was the aura of the Tianji Record, ancient and vast, as if Heaven's Way itself was watching him. "You..." he struggled to speak, his voice no longer carrying the arrogance from moments before, "What kind of monster are you?" Chen Ji did not answer, merely tossing the Xuanwu Token casually to Su Qingyao behind him, then surveying the crowd in the hall: "Fellow brothers and sisters, you have all witnessed today's events. Ling Yuan's treason is ironclad; I, Chen Ji, eliminated a threat for the sect, and my conscience is clear." His gaze swept over those who had once mocked and ridiculed him, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth, "If anyone wishes to follow in Ling Yuan's footsteps in the future, I, Chen Ji—await you anytime."

Everyone in the hall bowed in unison. Those elders who had been watching from the sidelines just moments ago now cowered in fear, terrified of offending this newly risen nemesis. Su Qingyao received the Xuanwu Token, her fingertips trembling slightly—she knew that from this moment on, the dynamics of the Tianqing Sect would be completely rewritten. And all of this was controlled by this seemingly ordinary young man before her. Mo Xiansheng sighed within his Mental Sea: "Young one, you played this move beautifully. However... did you hear the name Ling Yuan shouted before he died?" Chen Ji's heart tightened. Yes, he had heard it—in the instant when Ling Yuan was crushed by the power of the Tianji Record, a name spilled from the old man's lips, as clear as if carved into bone: "Heaven's... Eye..."

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, his usually composed voice carrying fear for the first time: "Impossible... why would it notice you? The existence of the Tianji Record itself is taboo, and it... it is—" The master's words cut off abruptly, as if some force was preventing him from speaking the truth. Outside the hall, a sudden fierce wind arose, dark clouds surging like a tide to envelop the entire Tianqing Sect in oppressive darkness. Chen Ji looked up at the sky, and within those dark clouds, there seemed to be an invisible eye coldly watching him—that gaze carried no emotion whatsoever, yet it made his back instantly drenched with cold sweat. Heaven's Eye... Chen Ji silently repeated these four characters in his heart, then suddenly smiled. That smile held three parts bitterness, three parts resolve, and four parts of a madness that even he himself could not explain.
